title: West Coast Bajau: Cowboys, Horses & Kota Belud Culture
text: West Coast Bajau speak the Bajau West dialect of the Sama-Bajau language family — an Austronesian language closely related to Tausug (spoken by the Suluk of East Sabah) and to various Philippine Sama languages. The language is also called Sama Taud or simply Bajau.
